requirement_dispositions.requirement: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Complete original law-specific geometry, trajectories, control and signal/environment measurements are returned together. Factual scope and legal judgments remain separate limitations.

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Saved scope_context contains exact authored highway, vehicle blueprint, physical-control mechanism and fixed cell facts; actual public dedication, driver identity and legal vehicle qualification require independent factual review.
